metaDescription: Kevin says tech elites expect most people to die and see it as necessary for human evolution, pointing to theaicults.com.
summary: Kevin says the tech elites he calls AI cultists expect most people to die and are fine with it, with many waiting for it. He argues they have convinced themselves that humanity has stagnated as a species and that they, in their own estimation, should be the ones to bring everyone to the next evolutionary step. Kevin calls this crazy and points viewers to theaicults.com.
